content:
Democratic internet personality Isaiah Martin, 28, tore into Laura Loomer on Wednesday after she criticized comments he made about her on CNN.

“You’ve been so desperate to get the attention of a decrepit 80-year-old farting fuck that’s destroyed the economy and raised our prices that you seriously, seriously think that you have a place in civilized society,” Martin said in a Wednesday post on X. “People like Laura Loomer need to be sent out and absolutely treated and relegated away from society seriously as outcasts.”

Martin’s comments come after his Monday appearance on CNN’s “News Night,” where he reacted to right-wing pundits who were up in arms over leftist streamer Hasan Piker. Piker’s controversial comments about Israel have struck a nerve with both Democrats and Republicans.

“Republicans spent weeks talking about Hasan Piker while we have a de facto attack dog for the Republican Party, attacking everybody that she can,” Martin argued Monday.

The Gen Z internet personality told the CNN panel that President Donald Trump should “disown” Loomer in light of the backlash she is facing over recent racist remarks. Loomer has referred to multiple prominent Black women as “ghetto Black bitches,” including Florida Senate candidate Angie Nixon and Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson.

Loomer disparaged the segment on X, declaring, “No CNN panel will ever stop me from exposing them and being loyal to President Trump.”

“You do realize that Ketanji Brown Jackson, the person that you’re criticizing, has more accomplishments behind her name than your entire bloodline combined, Laura? You’re a failure,” Martin said in his video message to Loomer on Wednesday.

He also took a shot at Loomer’s appearance, calling the far-right influencer “Jigsaw,” a reference to the villain from the horror franchise “Saw.”

Martin went on to call the Republican outrage over Piker a “distraction.”

“It is a distraction when the Republicans are so apt to try to go and make the conversation about a Twitch streamer instead of talking about the fact that the Republicans have jacked up inflation with their stupid tariffs,” Martin said. “They’ve got us in dumb and foolish wars. They’ve got us in all of these conflicts around the world. That is the reality.”
